[...] Nationally, Trump stands at 35 percent approval and 59 percent disapproval, producing a net approval rating of minus 24. This marks a substantial decline from where he stood when returning to office nearly two years ago, when he held a net approval of minus 10 in comparable 2018 midterm polling.
